[https://relay.firefox.com Firefox Relay] allows you to create email masks to protect your privacy while signing up for websites. You can now generate and manage these email masks directly from the Firefox [[Password Manager - Remember, delete and edit logins and passwords in Firefox|Password Manager]]. This article explains how to integrate Firefox Relay with Firefox Password Manager and manage your email masks seamlessly.

=Add Firefox Relay to Firefox Password Manager=
#Sign in to your Mozilla account.
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#Click {for not fx152}{menu Privacy & Security}{/for}{for fx152}{menu Privacy and security}{/for} on the left panel.
#Scroll down to the {for not fx152}''Passwords''{/for}{for fx152}''Additional protections''{/for} section and ensure the option for {for not fx152}'''Suggest Firefox Relay email masks to protect your email address'''{/for}{for fx152}'''Suggest Firefox Relay email masks'''{/for} is enabled with a checkmark[[Image:blue checkmark|width=25]].
#;{for not fx152}[[Image:Suggest relay pass|width=550]]{/for}{for fx152}[[Image:fx152additionalprotection]]{/for}
{note}'''Tip:''' You can manage your email masks and create more by visiting the [https://relay.firefox.com/accounts/profile/ Firefox Relay dashboard].{/note}

=Common questions=
==Why is Firefox Relay shown in my Password Manager?==
If you're using Firefox Relay, it’s now integrated into the Firefox Password Manager to help you easily use email masks while filling out forms.

==How many email masks can I use?==
With the free version of Firefox Relay, you can create up to 50 email masks. To unlock unlimited masks, consider upgrading to [[Subscribe to Firefox Relay Premium|Firefox Relay Premium]].

==Can I remove Firefox Relay from the Password Manager?==
Yes, you can disable the Firefox Relay integration in the Password Manager from the Firefox settings: [[Template:optionspreferences]] Select {for not fx152}{menu Privacy & Security}{/for}{for fx152}{menu Privacy and security}{/for} on the left, then uncheck the box next to {for not fx152}'''Suggest Firefox Relay email masks to protect your email address'''{/for}{for fx152}'''Suggest Firefox Relay email masks'''{/for}.
